message: I've always wanted to be the one who’s actually prepared when the lights go out, and I think I’ve finally found my way! The Red Cross has some great tips on how to handle power outages, which is super helpful for anyone looking to get their home ready for unexpected blackouts. It’s all about making sure you have a plan in place and a few essentials on hand — I’m feeling a lot more confident already! How do you usually prepare for a power outage?
